key.name: show-firefox-family
key.description: Include Firefox, Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp and related browsers in the menu.

key.name: show-chrome-family
key.description: Include Chromium, Chrome, Edge, Brave and related browsers in the menu.

key.name: show-simple-browsers
key.description: Include browsers without profile support (GNOME Web, qutebrowser, …) in the menu.

key.name: firefox-profile-groups-mode
key.description: How to display Firefox Profile Groups (Firefox 128+, separate from the classic Profile Manager). "spaces": show as space buttons under the matched profile entry. "profiles": list each selectable profile as its own menu entry. "off": ignore them entirely.

key.name: show-zen-spaces
key.description: Display workspace buttons under each Zen Browser profile entry.

key.name: show-default-browser-edit
key.description: Display the pencil button next to the default browser name that opens Default Applications settings.
